| succ N ih =>

  · subst N

    simpa using And.intro ht htN

    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hti⟩ := ih (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero) t ht hle
      exact ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi, hti⟩
    · exact ⟨N, Nat.lt_succ_self _, le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hle), by simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using htN⟩
